description: This file defines the ExoticFontsFontResolver class, which implements the IFontResolver interface. It maps font requests for specific font families to their embedded font resources, particularly for the SegoeWP fonts. The class provides methods to resolve typefaces based on family names and style parameters, and to retrieve font data bytes for the requested fonts.

classes.name: ExoticFontsFontResolver
classes.description: A font resolver mapping specific SegoeWP font family requests to embedded font resources, implementing the IFontResolver interface.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves font family, style (bold/italic) requests into a specific font resource if available.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font byte array for a given face name if available.
